title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta10

Focused active-error arbitration and command-contract diagnostics.

### Changed

- Make the Error sensor private-cloud canonical: repeated MQTT `Error` messages no longer overwrite a detailed cloud fault with generic `Error`.
- Use named MQTT Error transitions only to invalidate `index2`/`auth_list` and request one fast private refresh; repeated identical MQTT state does not trigger another error-driven poll.
- Show `No errors` when the Error sensor has no active cloud fault.
- Pause Maintenance and Mowing Reports H5 discovery in Download diagnostics for this beta.

### Added

- Preserve the un-normalized vendor Device notification feed in memory and expose a sanitized copy in diagnostics, including fields not retained by the public notification sensor.
- Add a dedicated public-H5 error action probe for the exact `Clear and resume`, `Reboot Mower` and `Got it` UI labels, translation keys, current error code/title, nearby request endpoints, command payload shapes and native bridge calls.
- Add MQTT error-transition evidence and current raw `index2.error_data` to the focused error-investigation diagnostics section.

### Safety

- Download diagnostics remains read-only. The error-action probe performs only bounded unauthenticated public HTTPS GETs.
- No `Clear and resume`, reboot, Resume, notification-detail/read, or other mower command is executed.
- The private current error code/title is used only as a local search term against already-downloaded public JavaScript and is never sent as mower identity.
